xs.$description: Content column max-width — narrow column (≈ short reading measure). Used by Section contentWidth='xs'.

md.$description: Content column max-width — medium (a comfortable reading measure).

2xl.$description: Content column max-width — widest constrained content.

3xs.$description: Component/utility min-max width — 5rem. For constraining small elements like icon buttons and compact controls.

2xs.$description: Component/utility min-max width — 10rem. For constraining narrow elements like number fields.

xs.$description: Component/utility min-max width — 15rem. For constraining compact components and kanban-style columns.

sm.$description: Component/utility min-max width — 20rem. For constraining narrow components.

md.$description: Component/utility min-max width — 25rem. For constraining medium-width components.

lg.$description: Component/utility min-max width — 30rem. For constraining wider components.

xl.$description: Component/utility min-max width — 40rem. For constraining large components.

2xl.$description: Component/utility min-max width — 50rem. For constraining the widest component constraints.
